It has always been thrilling for us to see you leave the bamboo abode and embark on your journey into the world of Jianghu in Where Winds Meet. 

Just like your first encounter with Jianghu, our initial attempt to connect with players around the globe has been both exciting and uncertain. But our passion and commitment to creating a living open world drive us forward, and your response and support to our efforts has been a tremendous encouragement, giving us the confidence to keep pushing ahead.

Since launch, we have been listening closely and working tirelessly to address the key areas where the experience has fallen short. We have made key progress in network connectivity and latency, localization and voiceovers, beginner tutorial, character customization, and more. We remain committed to ongoing improvements in essential areas such as localization, PS5 compatibility, and multi-character creation features in the near future.
Please check our official website or community posts for detailed updates and optimizations, and we welcome any further suggestions you may have.

While there is still much work to be done, we kindly ask for your patience as we continue to develop this world together with you. Thank you once again for supporting Where Winds Meet, we will not let you down!
